title: Solar Square
statement: A roof is a grid where 1 marks a tile that can hold a solar panel and 0 marks a tile that cannot. Return the area of the largest square made only of 1 tiles.

answerKey.pattern: 2-D DP: side(r, c) = 1 + min(above, left, above-left) for a 1 tile, else 0
keyPoints: side(r, c) is the largest square whose bottom-right corner is (r, c)
A square there needs squares above, to the left and diagonally
The answer is the largest side squared
edgeCases: All 1 tiles: the smaller side squared
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Check every square from every corner: O(rows · columns · side²)

hints: Think about squares that end at each tile (bottom-right corner).
A square of side k there needs side ≥ k − 1 above, to the left and up-left.
side = 1 + min of those three; track the maximum and return its square.
